framework.name: TISAX / VDA ISA
framework.description: TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) — VDA ISA 6.0 information security assessment for automotive supply chain. 55 requirements across 12 domains, scored 0–4.

objects.title: Information Security Policy
objects.description: Information security policy management, review, and responsibility assignment.

objects.title: Organisation of Information Security
objects.description: Management commitment, segregation of duties, and organisational information security responsibilities.

objects.title: Human Resources Security
objects.description: Personnel screening, security awareness, and obligations during and after employment.

objects.title: Physical & Environmental Security
objects.description: Physical perimeters, entry controls, environmental protection, and clean desk policies.

objects.title: Asset Management
objects.description: Asset inventory, ownership, classification, and acceptable use.

objects.title: Access Control
objects.description: Access control policy, user registration, privilege management, and remote access.

objects.title: Cryptography
objects.description: Cryptographic policy, key management, and encryption of data at rest and in transit.

objects.title: Supplier & Cloud Security
objects.description: Supplier policy, assessment, cloud service governance, and supply chain security.

objects.title: Incident Management
objects.description: Responsibilities and procedures for managing information security incidents.

objects.title: Business Continuity
objects.description: Business continuity planning, implementation, testing, and redundancy.

objects.title: Compliance
objects.description: Identification of applicable legislation, intellectual property rights, and technical compliance review.

objects.title: Prototype Protection
objects.description: Protection of prototypes, test vehicles, development data, and recording policies.

objects.title: Information Security Policy
objects.description: A formal information security policy exists, is approved by management, and is communicated to all employees.

objects.title: Review of the Information Security Policy
objects.description: The information security policy is reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

objects.title: Roles and Responsibilities
objects.description: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated.

objects.title: Contact with Authorities
objects.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities are maintained.

objects.title: Management Commitment
objects.description: Management actively supports information security through clear direction, demonstrated commitment, and explicit assignment of responsibilities.

objects.title: Segregation of Duties
objects.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorised or unintentional modification of assets.

objects.title: Information Security in Project Management
objects.description: Information security is addressed in project management.

objects.title: Confidentiality Agreements
objects.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements are identified and regularly reviewed.

objects.title: Screening
objects.description: Background verification checks on candidates for employment are carried out.

objects.title: Terms and Conditions of Employment
objects.description: Contractual agreements state employees' and contractors' information security responsibilities.

objects.title: Information Security Awareness and Training
objects.description: Employees and relevant contractors receive appropriate security awareness training.

objects.title: Disciplinary Process
objects.description: A formal and communicated disciplinary process exists for employees who commit an information security breach.

objects.title: Termination or Change
objects.description: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined and communicated.

objects.title: Physical Security Perimeter
objects.description: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas that contain sensitive or critical information and facilities.

objects.title: Physical Entry Controls
objects.description: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure only authorised personnel are allowed access.

objects.title: Securing Offices and Facilities
objects.description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities is designed and applied.

objects.title: Protection Against External and Environmental Threats
objects.description: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack, or accidents is designed and applied.

objects.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
objects.description: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities is adopted.

objects.title: Inventory of Assets
objects.description: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities are identified and an inventory of these assets is drawn up and maintained.

objects.title: Ownership of Assets
objects.description: Assets maintained in the inventory are owned by designated individuals.

objects.title: Acceptable Use of Assets
objects.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and assets associated with information and information processing facilities are identified, documented, and implemented.

objects.title: Classification of Information
objects.description: Information is classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality, and sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification.

objects.title: Handling of Assets
objects.description: Procedures for handling assets are developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme.

objects.title: Access Control Policy
objects.description: An access control policy is established, documented, and reviewed.

objects.title: User Registration and De-registration
objects.description: A formal user registration and de-registration process is implemented.

objects.title: Privilege Management
objects.description: Allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and controlled.

objects.title: Password Management
objects.description: Passwords are managed through a formal management process.

objects.title: Remote Access
objects.description: Remote access to systems is controlled and monitored.

objects.title: Cryptographic Policy
objects.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls is developed and implemented.

objects.title: Key Management
objects.description: A policy on the use, protection, and lifetime of cryptographic keys is developed and implemented.

objects.title: Encryption of Data at Rest
objects.description: Sensitive data stored on portable devices or removable media is encrypted.

objects.title: Encryption of Data in Transit
objects.description: Sensitive data transmitted over networks is encrypted.

objects.title: Supplier Policy
objects.description: Information security requirements for mitigating risks associated with supplier access are agreed and documented.

objects.title: Supplier Assessment
objects.description: Supplier information security is regularly assessed and monitored.

objects.title: Cloud Services
objects.description: Cloud service usage is governed by a policy covering risk assessment, contractual requirements, and monitoring.

objects.title: Supply Chain Security
objects.description: The supply chain is managed to identify and mitigate information security risks.

objects.title: Responsibilities and Procedures
objects.description: Management responsibilities and procedures are established to ensure a quick, effective, and orderly response to information security incidents.

objects.title: Reporting Security Events
objects.description: Information security events are reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

objects.title: Reporting Security Weaknesses
objects.description: Employees and contractors are required to note and report security weaknesses observed or suspected.

objects.title: Assessment of Events
objects.description: Security events are assessed and categorised as incidents or false positives.

objects.title: Response to Incidents
objects.description: Security incidents are responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

objects.title: Planning Business Continuity
objects.description: Information security continuity is embedded in the business continuity management system.

objects.title: Implementing Business Continuity
objects.description: The organisation establishes, documents, implements, and maintains processes, procedures, and controls to ensure business continuity.

objects.title: Testing Business Continuity
objects.description: Business continuity controls are tested and verified at regular intervals.

objects.title: Redundancies
objects.description: Redundancies are implemented to satisfy availability requirements.

objects.title: Identification of Applicable Legislation
objects.description: All relevant statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements are explicitly identified, documented, and kept up to date.

objects.title: Intellectual Property Rights
objects.description: Appropriate procedures are implemented to ensure compliance with legal requirements for intellectual property rights.

objects.title: Protection of Records
objects.description: Records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access, and unauthorised release.

objects.title: Technical Compliance Review
objects.description: Information systems are regularly reviewed for compliance with the organisation's information security policies and standards.

objects.title: Prototype Protection Policy
objects.description: A policy for the protection of prototypes, test vehicles, and development data is established and communicated.

objects.title: Physical Prototype Protection
objects.description: Physical access to prototypes and test vehicles is restricted to authorised personnel only.

objects.title: Data Protection for Prototypes
objects.description: Digital data related to prototypes (CAD files, test results) is classified, stored securely, and transmitted only via approved channels.

objects.title: Photography and Recording Policy
objects.description: Rules governing photography and recording in prototype-relevant areas are established and enforced.
